name: Estes Century
description:
Nice way to spend one of the last days before winter arrives. Kind Coffee @ Estes and Mountain Fountain @ Hygiene (first time!). Salted chocolate ice cream + Vafel is good. Brought a lot of gloves and layers but didn’t touch any of them. Great temperature all day if windy on Peak to Peak. Still can’t believe that I’ve never gotten a flat, knock on wood. My HR is so low biking because my legs are weak I guess? Hamstring isn’t getting worse but isn’t getting better.

Does anyone have the beta on Cables right now? Is it iced up for the season? Longs looks bone dry
